mark.13.p1.b1.text: As Jesus was leaving the temple,

mark.13.p1.b2.text: Teacher, look at the magnificent stones and buildings!

mark.13.p1.b3.text: Do you see all these great buildings?

mark.13.p1.b4.text: Not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.

mark.13.p2.b1.text: While Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple,

mark.13.p2.b2.text: Tell us, when will these things happen?

mark.13.p2.b3.text: And what will be the sign that they are about to be fulfilled?

mark.13.p3.b1.text: See to it that no one deceives you.

mark.13.p3.b2.text: Many will come in My name, claiming, ‘I am He,’ and will deceive many.

mark.13.p3.b3.text: When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be alarmed.

mark.13.p3.b4.text: These are the beginning of birth pains.

mark.13.p4.b1.text: So be on your guard. You will be delivered over to the councils

mark.13.p4.b2.text: On My account you will stand before governors and kings as witnesses to them.

mark.13.p4.b3.text: And the gospel must first be proclaimed to all the nations.

mark.13.p5.b1.text: But when they arrest you and hand you over, do not worry beforehand what to say.

mark.13.p5.b2.text: For it will not be you speaking, but the Holy Spirit.

mark.13.p5.b3.text: Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child.

mark.13.p5.b4.text: But the one who perseveres to the end will be saved.

mark.13.p6.b1.text: So when you see the abomination of desolation standing where it should not be …

mark.13.p6.b2.text: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

mark.13.p6.b3.text: Let no one on the housetop go back inside to retrieve anything from his house.

mark.13.p6.b4.text: And let no one in the field return for his cloak.

mark.13.p7.b1.text: How miserable those days will be for pregnant and nursing mothers!

mark.13.p7.b2.text: Pray that this will not occur in the winter.

mark.13.p7.b3.text: If the Lord had not cut short those days, nobody would be saved.

mark.13.p7.b4.text: But for the sake of the elect, whom He has chosen, He has cut them short.

mark.13.p8.b1.text: At that time if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or ‘There He is!’ do not believe it.

mark.13.p8.b2.text: For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform signs and wonders that would deceive even the elect, if that were possible.

mark.13.p8.b4.text: I have told you everything in advance.

mark.13.p9.b1.text: But in those days, after that tribulation:

mark.13.p9.b2.text: The sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light;

mark.13.p9.b3.text: The stars will fall from the sky,

mark.13.p9.b4.text: And the powers of the heavens will be shaken.

mark.13.p10.b1.text: At that time they will see the Son of Man coming in the clouds with great power and glory.

mark.13.p10.b2.text: And He will send out the angels to gather His elect from the four winds,

mark.13.p10.b3.text: From the ends of the earth to the ends of heaven.

mark.13.p11.b1.text: Now learn this lesson from the fig tree:

mark.13.p11.b2.text: As soon as its branches become tender and sprout leaves, you know that summer is near.

mark.13.p11.b3.text: So also, when you see these things happening, know that He is near, right at the door.

mark.13.p11.b4.text: Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.

mark.13.p12.b1.text: No one knows about that day or hour,

mark.13.p12.b2.text: Not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.

mark.13.p12.b3.text: Be on your guard and stay alert! For you do not know when the appointed time will come.

mark.13.p13.b1.text: It is like a man going on a journey who left his house, … and instructed the doorkeeper to keep watch.

mark.13.p13.b2.text: You do not know when the master of the house will return—whether in the evening, at midnight, when the rooster crows, or in the morning.

mark.13.p13.b3.text: Otherwise, he may arrive without notice and find you sleeping.

mark.13.p13.b4.text: And what I say to you, I say to everyone: Keep watch!
